scripts.server:dev: cd server && uv run uvicorn shiftmate.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.server:lint: cd server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd server && uv run python -m shiftmate.cli seed
scripts.demo:reset: cd server && uv run python -m shiftmate.cli reset-demo --yes
scripts.ml:generate: cd server && uv run python -m shiftmate_ml.datagen.generate --config ../data/generator/config.yaml
scripts.ml:train: pnpm voice:export-tokens && cd server && uv run python -m shiftmate_ml.train.estimator && uv run python -m shiftmate_ml.train.intent
